waypoints.name: High Bridge (PCT/Stehekin Valley Road)
waypoints.directions: No road reaches High Bridge from outside the valley. Take the passenger ferry or a floatplane up Lake Chelan to Stehekin, then the seasonal shuttle bus about 11 miles up the Stehekin Valley Road to High Bridge at about 1,600 ft, where the Agnes Creek Trail (PCT) starts.

waypoints.name: Agnes Mountain summit
waypoints.directions: Follow the PCT/Agnes Creek Trail south 8-10 miles to the Spruce Creek confluence. Cross Agnes and Spruce Creeks on logs and climb steeply northwest off-trail through brush, talus and slabs to Upper Blue Basin and a high camp near Icy-Spruce Pass (about 6,760 ft). Then go over Point 7458, climb the south-side snow couloir to the south col (about 7,480 ft), and follow the ridge and summit-block chimney to the top.
